nature_language: 当前位置杭州。我们两个人打算去上海玩两天，市内交通主要使用出租车，开一间大床房。请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Hangzhou. Two of us are planning to visit Shanghai for two days. We will primarily use taxis for transportation within the city and book a room with a king-size bed. Please provide me with a travel itinerary.
